schema.title: Farmers Market Stall Booking
schema.originalPrompt: A farmers market stall booking app where organizers assign stalls and vendors can only see their own booking.

components.name: Stall Booking Dashboard
components.purpose: Shows a vendor's assigned stalls and lets them check in.

components.name: Organizer Admin Panel
components.purpose: Lets an organizer assign stalls to vendors.

components.name: Public Market View
components.purpose: Shows all stalls and vendors for the day, visible to shoppers.

components.name: Bookings API
components.purpose: Records stall assignments and vendor check-ins.

components.name: Market Schedule Service
components.purpose: Generates daily stall assignments from the current season.

components.name: bookings table
components.purpose: Stores vendor id, stall id, and check-in status per booking.

components.name: Vendor-Scoped Booking View
components.purpose: Only shows a vendor their own bookings, never another vendor's.

components.name: Organizer-Only Admin Panel
components.purpose: Organizers can only manage bookings; vendors never see the admin panel.

constraints.rawText: Vendors can only see their own bookings, never another vendor's.
Organizers can only manage bookings; vendors never see the admin panel.
